sinopsis.es: Abrumado por no obtener suficientes ingresos debido a un desastre ambiental en el pueblo palafito donde vive, Elías, un joven pescador que posee una gaita heredada de su padre, pierde la cordura al fracasar en sus intentos de revivir los peces muertos de la ciénaga, aferrándose a los recuerdos de su esposa Margot, desaparecida a manos de los insurgentes. Pero el poder de la música y su tenacidad devolverán la esperanza al lugar.
sinopsis.en: Overwhelmed by not getting enough source of income due to an environmental disaster in the stilt village where he lives, ELÍAS; a young fisherman who owns a bagpipe inherited by his father, loses his sanity by failing in his attempts to revive the dead fish of the swamp, clinging to the memories of his wife MARGOT, who disappeared at the hands of the insurgents. But the power of music and its tenacity will bring hope back to the place.
